# Figure S6: Richness and native ASV proportions along elevation

```{r elevation_richness_plot}
sr_hight <-
  meta_data %>%
  filter(island == "Oahu") |>
  filter(commonname == "ʻōhiʻa Lehua") |>
  filter(sample_id != "KT1") |>
  filter(sample_id != "KA5") |>
  filter(!str_detect(shortname, "control")) |>
  drop_na(elevation) |>
  mutate(elev_arrow = case_when(
    elev_band == "High" ~ "\u25B2",  # ▲
    elev_band == "Mid"  ~ "\u25A0",  # ■
    elev_band == "Low"  ~ "\u25BC"   # ▼
    ),
    elevation_d = factor(elev_band, levels = c("High", "Mid", "Low"))
  )


# Place legend-only points outside the plotting range
legend_df_sr <- sr_hight %>%
  distinct(sample_site, elevation_m, elev_band) %>%
  mutate(x = max(sr_hight$elevation_m, na.rm = TRUE) + 1e6,
         y = max(sr_hight$richness, na.rm = TRUE) + 1e6) |>
  mutate(elevation_d = factor(elev_band))

sr_height_plot <-
  sr_hight %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(x = elevation_m, y = richness,
                 fill = sample_site, shape = elevation_d),
             size = 4, stroke = 1.1, color = "black", show.legend = FALSE) +
  # ridge-specific LMs (kept in legend)
  geom_smooth(aes(x = elevation_m, y = richness, color = sample_site),
              method = "lm", se = FALSE, size = 1.1) +
  # global LM (black; no legend)
  geom_smooth(aes(x = elevation_m, y = richness),
              method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", size = 1,
              show.legend = FALSE) +
  # legend-only points to expose SHAPE = elevation band
  geom_point(data = legend_df_sr,
             aes(x = x, y = y, color = sample_site, shape = elevation_d),
             size = 4, alpha = 1, stroke = 1.1, inherit.aes = FALSE, show.legend = TRUE) +
  scale_color_npg(
    name = "Ridge",
    guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linetype = 0, shape = 16, size = 4))
  ) +
  scale_fill_npg(guide = "none") +
  scale_shape_manual(
    name   = "Elevation band",
    breaks = c("High","Mid","Low"),
    values = c(High = 24, Mid = 22, Low = 25)  # ▲ ■ ▼
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(250, 1250), c(12,100)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "ASV richness") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text  = element_text(size = 11))
```

```{r richness_linear_model}
mod1 <- lm(richness ~ elevation_m, data = sr_hight)
summary(mod1)
```

```{r richness_ridge_model}
mod2 <- lm(richness ~ elevation_m + sample_site, data = sr_hight)
summary(mod2)
```

```{r richness_mixed_model}
mod3 <- lmer(richness ~ elevation_m + (1|sample_site), data = sr_hight)
summary(mod3)
```

```{r native_proportion_plot}
# uses presence (ZOTU present in sample) to avoid read-count bias
# requires: zotu_df (wide, sample_id + zotu* cols), meta_data, status (zotu_id + NiClassify)


# 1) long presence table
zotu_long <-
  zotu_df |>
  pivot_longer(starts_with("zotu"), names_to = "zotu", values_to = "reads") |>
  filter(reads > 0)

# Load NIClassify nativeness predictions
status <- read.csv(here::here("NIClassify/06_NIClassify_predict.csv")) |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  dplyr::rename(zotu_id = upid) |>
  mutate(zotu_id = tolower(zotu_id)) |>
  filter(str_detect(zotu_id, "zotu")) |>
  select(zotu_id, status_final = final_status, status_ni = predict)

# 3) clean classifier labels and join
classif <-
  status |>
  select(zotu_id, NiClassify = status_ni) |>
  mutate(NiClassify = tolower(NiClassify)) |>
  rename(zotu = zotu_id) |>
  mutate(cls = case_when(
    str_to_lower(NiClassify) %in% c("native","endemic") ~ "native",
    str_to_lower(NiClassify) %in% c("introduced","invasive","non-native") ~ "introduced",
    TRUE ~ "unknown"
  )) |>
  select(zotu, cls)

samp_comp <-
  zotu_long |>
  inner_join(classif, by = "zotu") |>
    filter(!str_detect(sample_id, "control")) |>
  filter(!str_detect(sample_id, "CH|H")) |>
  filter(!str_detect(sample_id, "KT1")) |>
  filter(!str_detect(sample_id, "KA5")) |>
  filter(!str_detect(sample_id, "K_|G_")) |>
  mutate(cls = replace_na(cls, "unknown")) |>
  count(sample_id, cls, name = "n_zotus") |>
  group_by(sample_id) |>
  mutate(pct = n_zotus / sum(n_zotus)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(sample_id, cls, pct) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = cls, values_from = pct, values_fill = 0) |>
  # guarantee columns exist
  mutate(native = ifelse(is.na(native), 0, native),
         introduced = ifelse(is.na(introduced), 0, introduced))

# Join sample metadata for the standardized ʻōhiʻa gradients
invasion_heigt <-
  meta_data |>
    filter(!str_detect(sample_id, "control")) |>
    filter(!str_detect(sample_id, "CH|H")) |>
    filter(!str_detect(sample_id, "KT1")) |>
    filter(!str_detect(sample_id, "KA5")) |>
    filter(!str_detect(sample_id, "K_|G_")) |>
    select(sample_id, sample_site, elevation_m, richness, elev_band) |>
    inner_join(samp_comp, by = "sample_id") |>
    mutate(
      elev_arrow = case_when(
        elev_band == "High" ~ "\u25B2",   # ▲
        elev_band == "Mid"  ~ "\u25A0",   # ■
        elev_band == "Low"  ~ "\u25BC",   # ▼
        TRUE ~ "\u25CF"                    # • fallback
      ),
      elevation_d = factor(elev_band, levels = c("High", "Mid", "Low"))
    )

# legend-only layer (off-plot) for shapes
legend_df_inv <- invasion_heigt %>%
  distinct(sample_site, elevation_m, elev_band) %>%
  mutate(x = max(invasion_heigt$elevation_m, na.rm = TRUE) + 1e6,
         y = max(invasion_heigt$native * 100, na.rm = TRUE) + 1e6) |>
  mutate(elevation_d = factor(elev_band))


invasion_height_plot <-
  invasion_heigt %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(x = elevation_m, y = native * 100,
                 fill = sample_site, shape = elevation_d),
             size = 4, stroke = 1.1, color = "black", show.legend = FALSE) +
  # ridge-specific lms (keep in legend)
  geom_smooth(aes(x = elevation_m, y = native * 100, color = sample_site),
              method = "lm", se = FALSE, size = 1.1) +
  # global lm (no legend)
  geom_smooth(aes(x = elevation_m, y = native * 100),
              method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", size = 1,
              show.legend = FALSE) +
  # legend-only points to expose shapes for elevation
  geom_point(data = legend_df_inv,
             aes(x = x, y = y, color = sample_site, shape = elevation_d),
             size = 4, alpha = 1, stroke = 1.1, inherit.aes = FALSE, show.legend = TRUE) +
  scale_color_npg(
    name = "Ridge",
    guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linetype = 0, shape = 16, size = 4))
  ) +
  scale_fill_npg(guide = "none") +
  scale_shape_manual(
    name   = "Elevation band",
    breaks = c("High","Mid","Low"),
    values = c(High = 24, Mid = 22, Low = 25)  # ▲ ■ ▼
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(250,1250), c(20,77)) +
  labs(x = "Elevation (m)", y = "% Native (presence-based)") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text  = element_text(size = 11))
```

```{r elevation_linear_models}
mod4 <- lm(I(native*100) ~ richness, data = invasion_heigt)
mod5 <- lm(I(native*100) ~ elevation_m, data = invasion_heigt)
mod6 <- lm(richness ~ elevation_m, data = invasion_heigt)

summary(mod4)
summary(mod5)
summary(mod6)
```

```{r elevation_mixed_models}
# % native ~ richness + elevation, random intercept for ridge
m_nat_mix <- lmer(I(native*100) ~ richness + elevation_m + (1|sample_site), data = invasion_heigt)

# % introduced ~ richness + elevation, random intercept for ridge
m_intro_mix <- lmer(I(introduced*100) ~ richness + elevation_m + (1|sample_site), data = invasion_heigt)

# Richness ~ elevation, random intercept for ridge
m_rich_mix <- lmer(richness ~ elevation_m + (1|sample_site), data = invasion_heigt)

summary(m_nat_mix)
summary(m_intro_mix)
summary(m_rich_mix)
```

```{r elevation_panel}
height_cont_panel <-
sr_height_plot / invasion_height_plot + plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A", tag_suffix = ")") &
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.box = "vertical"
  )

height_cont_panel

save_fig(
  tag = "S6_elevation_richness_invasion",
  plot = height_cont_panel,
  which = "supp",
  prefix = "none",
  width = 10,
  height = 12,
  dpi = 600
)
```

# Figure S7: Rainfall, richness and native ASV proportions

```{r rainfall_elevation_plot}
meta_oahu <- meta_data %>%
  filter(island == "Oahu") %>%
  mutate(elevation = fct_recode(as.factor(elevation),
                                High = "high", Mid = "mid", Low = "low"))

rain_elev_plot <-
  ggplot(meta_oahu, aes(x = elevation_m, y = rainfall)) +
  # use fill for Ridge colors + shape for elevation band
  geom_point(aes(fill = sample_site, shape = elevation),
             size = 4, color = "black", stroke = 1.1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, color = "black", span = 0.9) +
  # legends: shapes = elevation band, filled points = ridge
  scale_shape_manual(
    name   = "Elevation band",
    breaks = c("High","Mid","Low"),
    values = c(High = 24, Mid = 22, Low = 25)  # ▲ ■ ▼
  ) +
  scale_fill_npg(name = "Ridge") +
  guides(
    # make the Ridge legend use a fillable symbol so colors show up
    fill  = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21, size = 4, color = "black"), order = 2),
    shape = guide_legend(order = 1)
  ) +
  labs(x = "Elevation (m)", y = "Rainfall (mm)") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 11)
  ) +
  guides(color = "none",
         shape = "none",
         fill = "none")
```

```{r rainfall_response_plots}
invasion_heigt <-
  meta_data |>
    filter(!str_detect(sample_id, "control")) |>
    filter(!str_detect(sample_id, "CH|H")) |>
    filter(!str_detect(sample_id, "KT1")) |>
    filter(!str_detect(sample_id, "KA5")) |>
    filter(!str_detect(sample_id, "K_|G_")) |>
    select(sample_id, sample_site, elevation_m, rainfall, richness, elev_band) |>
    inner_join(samp_comp, by = "sample_id") |>
    mutate(
      elev_arrow = case_when(
        elev_band == "High" ~ "\u25B2",   # ▲
        elev_band == "Mid"  ~ "\u25A0",   # ■
        elev_band == "Low"  ~ "\u25BC",   # ▼
        TRUE ~ "\u25CF"
      ),
      elevation_d = factor(elev_band, levels = c("High", "Mid", "Low"))
    )


# legend-only points placed *inside* the panel
legend_df_rain_sr <- sr_hight |>
  distinct(sample_site, elev_band) |>
  mutate(
    x = max(sr_hight$rainfall, na.rm = TRUE) + 1e6,   # well outside x axis
    y = max(sr_hight$richness, na.rm = TRUE) + 1e6,   # well outside y axis
    elevation_d = factor(elev_band, levels = c("High","Mid","Low"))
  )

rain_rich_plot <-
  sr_hight |>
    ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = rainfall, y = richness, fill = sample_site, shape = elevation_d),
    size = 4, stroke = 1.1, color = "black", show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  # ridge-specific LMs (stay in legend)
  geom_smooth(aes(x = rainfall, y = richness, color = sample_site),
              method = "lm", se = FALSE, size = 1.1, show.legend = FALSE) +
  # global LM (black; no legend)
  geom_smooth(aes(x = rainfall, y = richness),
              method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", size = 1,
              show.legend = FALSE) +
  # legend-only points to expose fill (ridge) + shape (elevation)
  geom_point(data = legend_df_rain_sr,
             aes(x = 0, y = 0, fill = sample_site, shape = elevation_d),
             color = "black", size = 4, alpha = 1, stroke = 1.1, inherit.aes = FALSE, show.legend = TRUE) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(min(sr_hight$rainfall, na.rm = TRUE) - 50,
                           max(sr_hight$rainfall, na.rm = TRUE) + 50)) +
  scale_color_npg(guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_npg(name = "Ridge") +
  scale_shape_manual(
    name   = "Elevation band",
    breaks = c("High","Mid","Low"),
    values = c(High = 24, Mid = 22, Low = 25)   # ▲ ■ ▼
  ) +
  labs(x = "Rainfall (mm)", y = "ASV richness") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text  = element_text(size = 11)) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      order = 2,
      override.aes = list(shape = 21, size = 4, color = "black", linetype = 0)
    ),
    shape = guide_legend(
      order = 1,
      override.aes = list(fill = NA, color = "black", linetype = 0)
    )
  )

# legend-only points for shapes (use elevation band), invisible in panel
legend_df_rain_nat <- invasion_heigt |>
  distinct(sample_site, elev_band) |>
  mutate(
    elevation_d = factor(elev_band, levels = c("High","Mid","Low"))
  )

rain_native_plot <-
  invasion_heigt |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = rainfall, y = native * 100, fill = sample_site, shape = elevation_d),
    size = 4, stroke = 1.1, color = "black", show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  # ridge-specific LMs (kept in legend)
  geom_smooth(aes(x = rainfall, y = native * 100, color = sample_site),
              method = "lm", se = FALSE, size = 1.1, show.legend = FALSE) +
  # global LM (black; no legend)
  geom_smooth(aes(x = rainfall, y = native * 100),
              method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", size = 1,
              show.legend = FALSE) +
  # legend-only points to expose SHAPE = elevation band
  geom_point(data = legend_df_rain_nat,
             aes(x = 0, y = 0, fill = sample_site, shape = elevation_d),
             color = "black", size = 4, alpha = 1, stroke = 1.1, inherit.aes = FALSE, show.legend = TRUE) +
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(min(invasion_heigt$rainfall, na.rm = TRUE) - 50,
             max(invasion_heigt$rainfall, na.rm = TRUE) + 50)
  ) +
  scale_color_npg(guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_npg(name = "Ridge") +
  scale_shape_manual(
    name   = "Elevation band",
    breaks = c("High","Mid","Low"),
    values = c(High = 24, Mid = 22, Low = 25)   # ▲ ■ ▼
  ) +
  labs(x = "Rainfall (mm)", y = "% Native (presence-based)") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text  = element_text(size = 11)) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      order = 2,
      override.aes = list(shape = 21, size = 4, color = "black", linetype = 0)
    ),
    shape = guide_legend(
      order = 1,
      override.aes = list(fill = NA, color = "black", linetype = 0)
    )
  )
```
